3490-5477-6965-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5477-6965-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

730-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4153-5231--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

1494-4444-7720-7811.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Iron Man triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1479-3861-5362.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-5173-5686.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5086-5183-6441-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6441-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2842-4496-5220-6900.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2438-5058-7396.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

206-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
206-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

703-5241-7149.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Sakashima's Student enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Sakashima's Students into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Sakashima's Student tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-5241-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

1719-2628-6185-7330.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1719-2628-6185-7330.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7160.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

396-4050-6073-6992.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 7 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
396-4050-6073-6992.description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
When Leonardo enters, Angelic Sell-Sword and Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2275-3532-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
2275-3532-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3054-3416-5670-6559.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5670-6559.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2466-5051-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2466-5051-5078-6650.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3918-3980-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sisay's Ring's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

1902-5137-6287.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Morphling and Wirewood Channeler are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
1902-5137-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Morphling.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1698-2510-3260-3540.notablePrerequisites:
There is an enchantment card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-2510-3260-3540.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-2510-3260-3540.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

1657-5805.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
1657-5805.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
Murderous Redcap enters, triggering itself, dealing damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and at least one +1/+1 counter from Gev.
The -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter are both removed as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 2.

175-3013-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3013-4222.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

1912-2544-3371.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2544-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

358-1368-2081.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
358-1368-2081.description:
Cast Culling the Weak for its escape cost by paying {B}, exling three other cards from your graveyard, and sacrificing Stiticher's Supplier.
Stitcher's Supplier dies, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

2034-2703-2713-4068.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator, adding {2}.
Repeat.

967-1806-2034-2604-4666.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2781-5147-5210.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least four loyalty counters.
2781-5147-5210.description:
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage.
Activate Liliana's -3 ability to return Felidar Guardian to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Liliana and return it to the battlefield with 5 loyalty.
Repeat.

1534-4276-4621.notablePrerequisites: Lands that produce {3}{U} on the battlefield.
1534-4276-4621.description:
Cast Turnabout for {2}{U}{U}.
In response, Cast Twincast targeting Turnabout for {U}{U}.
In response, Activate Izzet Guildmage's ability for {2}{U} targeting Twincast.
Resolve the Izzet Guildmage's activated ability to copy Twincast targeting Turnabout with the copy of Twincast.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, created by the copy of Twincast to untap your lands that can produce at least {3}{U}.
Repeat.

1283-1987-3075-3277.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1283-1987-3075-3277.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

1987-2510-4125.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2510-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
